title: Do two or three short cold immersions per week.
subtitle: Cold immersion standard
rationale: Move from shower finishes to deliberate immersions of one to three minutes, keeping each dose short and controlled.

evidence.summary: Reviews of voluntary cold-water exposure report acute catecholamine and mood effects; long-term health outcomes are debated and understudied.

sources.label: Voluntary cold-water exposure health effects review

indications: Cold shower finishes are already routine and easy.
A plunge, cold tub, or open water is practically available.
avoidWhen: Cardiovascular disease or arrhythmia unless cleared by a physician.
